blocks.text: Emerging Technologies
Emerging technologies are new or rapidly developing technologies that have the potential to change how people live, work, communicate, and solve problems.
Artificial Intelligence

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that enables machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, recognising images, understanding speech, and making decisions.
Internet of Things

The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to physical devices connected to the Internet that can collect, share, and act on data. Examples include smart watches, smart lights, smart cameras, and soil-monitoring sensors.
Cloud Computing
Cloud computing is the use of Internet-based services to store data, run applications, and access computing resources without depending only on a local computer or server.
Blockchain
Blockchain is a digital record-keeping technology in which data is stored in linked blocks. It is commonly used to support secure, transparent, and tamper-resistant transactions.
Stakeholders
Stakeholders are individuals or groups affected by a technology system. In AI systems, stakeholders may include users, developers, organisations, governments, and society.
Ethical AI
Ethical AI means designing and using AI systems in a fair, transparent, accountable, safe, and responsible manner.
Bias in AI
Bias in AI occurs when an AI system gives unfair results because of biased data, poor design, or unequal representation of different groups.
Inclusivity
Inclusivity means designing technology so that it can serve people from different genders, cultures, languages, regions, and backgrounds fairly.
Conflict of Interest
A conflict of interest occurs when the goals or benefits of one stakeholder may negatively affect the rights, safety, or interests of others.
AI Governance
AI governance refers to the rules, policies, and guidelines used to ensure that AI systems are developed and used responsibly.
Responsible Innovation
Responsible innovation means creating technology that solves real problems while considering ethics, safety, culture, fairness, and long-term social impact.
Smart Agriculture
Smart agriculture is the use of technologies such as IoT, AI, cloud computing, and blockchain to improve farming.
Technology Integration

Technology integration means combining different technologies to build a more useful solution. For example, an agriculture system may use IoT for data collection, AI for prediction, cloud computing for storage, and blockchain for secure records.
Policy and Legal Frameworks
Policy and legal frameworks are rules and laws that guide how technologies should be developed, used, and controlled to protect individuals, organisations, and society.
